messages:
sylvia: quick brain dump after reading the RFC followup — proposing a 'shape-aware cohort affinity' model that groups requests by (prefix-hash, token-length-bin, model-variant) so we keep KV locality while letting windows be elastic.
ben: interesting. how does this differ from the cohort merge idea we already discussed?
sylvia: two differences: (1) affinity is a soft clustering (not hard cohorts) so requests carry an affinity tag and scheduler prefers to coalesce same-affinity items but can still batch across affinities under pressure; (2) we run a tiny auction for headroom credits rather than pre-allocating per-cohort.
omar: auction for credits? elaborate pls — sounds like extra complexity in the hot path.
sylvia: not on hot path. it's a micro-auction run at admission time when a batch wants to expand. bidders = active affinities in that shard. they bid using amortized urgency score (age * priority / tokens). winner gets extra headroom tokens for next N ms.
tia: neat — that should help fairness vs greedy tenants. what are failure modes?
sylvia: a few: noisy auction spam, oscillation where an affinity keeps winning, and bookkeeping overhead. mitigations: rate-limit bids, additive-increase/backoff to avoid oscillation, and compact bid records (decay counters).
ben: what's tradeoff versus simpler per-tenant caps? Auctions sound fairer but ops will want predictable memory and billing.
sylvia: we keep a fallback: if auctions are disabled, fall back to static headroom per-tenant/shape with soft TTL. billing visibility is tracked via metrics.
omar: KV cache warmup — how do we guarantee prefix locality if affinity is soft? merging across affinities could harm KV hit-rate.
sylvia: two mitigations: affinity-aware fast-path microbatches (size=small, for warmup), and a sticky-warmup token that reserves the next microbatch to the affinity that did the warmup for a short window. sticky token decays quickly.
tia: proto plan?
sylvia: propose: prototype sim + tiny in-memory scheduler shim in `devcluster` that implements: affinity tagging, auction logic (configurable), sticky-warmup, and 3 evict policies (drop-low, fallback-route, delayed-retry). run against traces from last 30 days.
ben: define metrics we need: affinity_hit_rate, auction_winners_per_min, headroom_tokens_allocated, sticky_token_holds, fallback_routing_rate, tail_p95/p99. also memory_delta_per_shard.
omar: one more: operator experience. add feature flag `affinity_auction_v1` and a kill-switch that converts affinities to pure FIFO. ops-bot: reminder: please register metrics before any rollout; alert for auction_thundering and affinity_map_spike. :bell:
stia: typo — that was me. otherwise +1 to sim. can we aim for a 2-week spike-free sandbox run after dev prototype?
sylvia: yes. I'll draft sim design today and assign tasks. thanks all.
ops-bot: meeting-scheduler: synced — review proto on Wednesday 11am PT. invite sent. :calendar:
